articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.snippet: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
articles.snippet: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”

articles.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum with institutional controls
articles.snippet: The proposed service would offer sanctions screening and qualified validators, but current compensation for failed commitments is set at zero.

articles.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
articles.snippet: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

articles.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
articles.snippet: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep, days after markets misjudged Brazil’s runoff.
